papers.title: Thermal behavior in single track during selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg powder
papers.first_author_affiliation: The State Key Laboratory for Manufacturing Systems Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, 710049, China

corresponding_authors.name: Pei Wei
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The State Key Laboratory for Manufacturing Systems Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, 710049, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究铝合金SLM单道热行为，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳及骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration; focuses on thermal behavior of single tracks, not biomedical implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM过程中单道熔池热行为对成型质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过有限元模拟分析AlSi10Mg粉末单道扫描的温度场和热循环。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了扫描速度和功率对熔池尺寸和温度梯度的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 可能通过实验测温或熔池形貌对比验证模拟结果。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the thermal behavior of a single track during selective laser melting and its impact on build quality.
summary_en.method: Finite element simulation was used to analyze the temperature field and thermal cycles of a single track on AlSi10Mg powder.
summary_en.result: The influence of scan speed and laser power on melt pool dimensions and temperature gradient was revealed.
summary_en.validation: The simulation results were likely validated by experimental temperature measurements or melt pool morphology observations.
